repo_notes.content: This repository is an extension for the AstrBot plugin astrbot_plugin_disaster_warning. The host plugin is in a different repository. The extension is not a standalone program. The repository root is the extension root, and the host calls setup(api) in extension.py.

The extension data is for reference only. It is not an official warning. Each page about alerts must keep this statement. Do not tell a reader to use this extension in place of the Defesa Civil or local authorities.

Time zones: the rain gauge field datahoraUltimovalor is in UTC, and the code changes it to Brasília time. The alert field atualizado is in UTC. The code treats datahoracriacao and ult_atualizacao as Brasília time, but the data does not prove this. Do not state that as a fact. See docs/CEMADEN API.md.
El Niño and La Niña data is background data. It is not the cause of an alert. Do not write that it causes an alert.
Do not document .claude/skills/asd-ste100. It is a vendored skill for contributors. It is not part of the extension. The .host directory is a local copy of the host and is not in the repository.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Explain what the extension does, the region and hazards that it covers, the host plugin that it needs, and the limits of the data. Use README.md and meta.json.

pages.title: Installation and Configuration
pages.purpose: Document the manual installation, the rule that the directory name must be the same as the extension id, and each setting with its default. Use README.md and settings.py.

pages.title: Architecture
pages.purpose: Show how the modules work together: setup in extension.py registers the sources, the presenter and the pollers. Show the data flow from a feed to an event envelope. Use extension.py, pollers.py and extension.yaml.

pages.title: CEMADEN Feeds and Parsers
pages.purpose: Document the alert and rain gauge feeds, the level mapping, the rule for an active alert, the rain thresholds and how parsers skip bad rows. Use cemaden.py and docs/CEMADEN API.md.

pages.title: ENSO Background Data
pages.purpose: Document the ONI file, the strength classes, the 24 hour cache and the retry after a failure. Use enso.py and docs/NOAA CPC ONI.md.

pages.title: Duplicate Control and Envelopes
pages.purpose: Document how AlertState and RainState stop repeated messages, and how the event ids and envelopes are made. Use tracking.py and envelopes.py.

pages.title: Messages and Languages
pages.purpose: Document the message text, the locale files and the rule that zh-CN must have all keys. Use presenter.py and the locale directory.

pages.title: Data Sources
pages.purpose: Describe the CEMADEN and NOAA CPC sources, and the survey of other Brazilian sources. Use meta.json, docs/CEMADEN API.md, docs/NOAA CPC ONI.md and docs/brazil-sources-survey.md.

pages.title: Development and Testing
pages.purpose: Document the just commands, the Nix shell, the pinned host, the test files and the release zip. Use justfile, flake.nix, pyproject.toml and the tests directory.
